```{=html}
<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     JAVASCRIPT — key gate logic
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<script>
// Config is loaded from config.json at page load so the admin
// can change keys or unlock tiers by editing that one file on GitHub.
let workshopConfig = null;
let activeProfile  = null;
// On Cloudflare (config.json says gate: "server") the account service decides what is open.
// cloudMe holds its answer from /api/me, or stays null when it cannot be reached.
// On GitHub Pages there is no account service and the workshop keys work as before.
let cloudMe = null;
function serverGate() { return !!(workshopConfig && workshopConfig.gate === 'server'); }

// ── Profile + self-study progress ─────────────────────────
// Everything a profile shows comes through WSProfile. Today it reads this browser's
// localStorage (the game's save 'rq:v1', the plan ticks 'ws-plan:<track>', the step ticks
// 'ws-path-done', the keys entered 'ws-unlocked' and the name 'ws-profile'). A real account system replaces read()/write().
var WSProfile = (function () {
  function read(key, fallback) {
    try { var v = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key)); return v == null ? fallback : v; } catch (e) { return fallback; }
  }
  function write(key, value) { try { localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value)); } catch (e) {} }

  // Same XP rules and ranks as dungeons/assets/quest.js (keep the two in step).
  var RANKS = [[0, 'Field Volunteer'], [100, 'Health Worker'], [250, 'Medical Officer'], [500, 'Epidemiologist'],
               [900, 'Senior Epidemiologist'], [1500, 'Chief Biostatistician']];
  function itemXP(r) {
    if (!r || !r.solved || r.shown) return 0;
    var cost = 0, hint = [3, 5, 8];
    for (var i = 0; i < (r.hints || 0); i++) cost += hint[Math.min(i, 2)];
    var factor = r.tries <= 1 ? 1 : r.tries === 2 ? 0.5 : 0.25;
    return Math.max(0, Math.round(({ 1: 10, 2: 20, 3: 30 }[r.diff] || 10) * factor - cost) + (r.boss ? 50 : 0));
  }
  function game() {
    var g = read('rq:v1', null) || {}, xp = 0, k;
    for (k in (g.items || {})) xp += itemXP(g.items[k]);
    var rank = RANKS[0], next = null;
    RANKS.forEach(function (r, i) { if (xp >= r[0]) { rank = r; next = RANKS[i + 1] || null; } });
    return {
      xp: xp, rank: rank[1], next: next,
      pct: next ? Math.round(100 * (xp - rank[0]) / (next[0] - rank[0])) : 100,
      streak: (g.streak && g.streak.count) || 0,
      badges: Object.keys(g.badges || {}).length
    };
  }
  return {
    name: function () { return (read('ws-profile', {}).name || '').trim(); },
    saveName: function (n) { write('ws-profile', { name: n.trim().slice(0, 40) }); },
    game: game,
    steps: function () { return read('ws-path-done', {}); },
    saveSteps: function (d) { write('ws-path-done', d); },
    planDone: function (track) { return Object.keys(read('ws-plan:' + track, {})).length; },
    planTotal: function (track, fallback) { return read('ws-plan-total:' + track, 0) || fallback; },
    tests: function () { return (read('rq:v1', null) || {}).tests || {}; },
    // Deck quizzes (quiz.js keeps 'quiz-score:<workshop folder>/<deck>': { questionId: right? }).
    // Returns { decks: decks with an answer, right, answered } for the given workshop folders.
    quizzes: function (folders) {
      var out = { decks: 0, right: 0, answered: 0 };
      for (var i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
        var k = localStorage.key(i), m = /^quiz-score:([^\/]+)\//.exec(k || '');
        if (!m || folders.indexOf(m[1]) < 0) continue;
        var v = read(k, {}), ids = Object.keys(v);
        if (!ids.length) continue;
        out.decks++; out.answered += ids.length;
        ids.forEach(function (id) { if (v[id]) out.right++; });
      }
      return out;
    },
    unlocked: function () { return read('ws-unlocked', {}); },
    unlock: function (track) { var u = read('ws-unlocked', {}); u[track] = 1; write('ws-unlocked', u); }
  };
})();


// ── FIX 1: Loading state helpers ─────────────────────────
// All buttons start disabled (set in HTML above).
// removeLoadingState() re-enables them after config is fetched.
// This prevents the /docs/null/index.html race condition where
// enterTrack() was called before workshopConfig was populated.
function removeLoadingState() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.ws-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.classList.remove('ws-btn--loading');
  });
}

async function loadConfig() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('config.json');
    workshopConfig = await res.json();
    if (serverGate()) {
      try {
        const me = await fetch('/api/me', { credentials: 'same-origin' });
        if (me.ok) cloudMe = await me.json();
        // Progress sync (ws-sync.js, added to every page on Cloudflare) follows the account.
        if (cloudMe && window.WSSync) {
          if (cloudMe.user) window.WSSync.signedIn(cloudMe.user.id); else window.WSSync.sessionEnded();
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Account service unavailable; showing free tracks only.');
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    // If config.json can't be fetched (e.g. local file:// preview),
    // fall back to locked state for all non-basic profiles.
    console.warn('config.json not available — defaulting to locked state.');
  } finally {
    // ── Always re-enable buttons, whether fetch succeeded or failed
    applyLockStates();
    removeLoadingState();
  }
}


// A track is unlocked when config.json says so, or when its key was entered in this
// browser before (remembered through WSProfile).
function isUnlocked(id) {
  if (serverGate()) return cloudMe ? !!cloudMe.open[id] : (id === 'basic' || id === 'dungeons');
  const cfg = workshopConfig && workshopConfig.profiles[id];
  return (cfg ? !cfg.locked : id === 'basic') || !!WSProfile.unlocked()[id];
}

// Where a locked track sends you on Cloudflare: the account page, which offers sign-in or says
// which product to ask the organiser for.
function accountUrl(id) {
  const need = cloudMe && cloudMe.tracks ? cloudMe.tracks[id] : '';
  return '/account?' + (need ? 'need=' + encodeURIComponent(need) + '&' : '') +
    'next=' + encodeURIComponent('/' + id + '/welcome');
}

function applyLockStates() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.ws-card[data-profile]').forEach(card => {
    const id = card.dataset.profile;
    if (!isUnlocked(id)) {
      if (serverGate()) {
        const badge = card.querySelector('.ws-card-badge');
        if (badge) badge.textContent = cloudMe && cloudMe.user ? '🔒 Not in your account' : '🔒 Sign in';
        const btn = card.querySelector('.ws-btn');
        if (btn) btn.textContent = cloudMe && cloudMe.user ? 'How to unlock →' : 'Sign in →';
      }
      return;
    }
    card.classList.remove('ws-card--locked');
    card.classList.add('ws-card--open');
    const badge = card.querySelector('.ws-card-badge');
    if (badge) { badge.textContent = '🟢 Open Access'; badge.className = 'ws-card-badge ws-badge--open'; }
    const btn = card.querySelector('.ws-btn');
    if (btn) {
      btn.className = 'ws-btn ws-btn--open';
      btn.textContent = 'Enter Track →';
      btn.setAttribute('onclick', `enterTrack('${id}')`);
    }
  });
  if (serverGate()) {
    const sub = document.getElementById('ws-plan-sub');
    if (sub) sub.textContent = 'Four steps, in order. Each step is a track with its own day-by-day plan inside. ' +
      'Step 1 is open to everyone; the others open when your account includes them.';
  }
  if (window.wsRefreshProfile) window.wsRefreshProfile();
}


function enterTrack(profileId) {
  const cfg = workshopConfig && workshopConfig.profiles[profileId];
  // Changed docs/${profileId}/index.html to just ${profileId}/welcome.html
  const path = cfg ? cfg.path : `${profileId}/welcome.html`; 
  window.location.href = path;
}


function openKeyModal(profileId) {
  activeProfile = profileId;
  const cfg = workshopConfig && workshopConfig.profiles[profileId];

  // Open track, or key already entered in this browser: go straight in
  if (isUnlocked(profileId)) { enterTrack(profileId); return; }
  // Cloudflare: no keys; the account page explains how to get access
  if (serverGate()) { activeProfile = null; window.location.href = accountUrl(profileId); return; }

  document.getElementById('modal-track-name').textContent =
    cfg ? cfg.label : profileId;
  document.getElementById('ws-key-input').value = '';
  document.getElementById('ws-key-error').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('ws-modal-overlay').style.display = 'flex';
  setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('ws-key-input').focus(), 50);
}


function closeKeyModal() {
  document.getElementById('ws-modal-overlay').style.display = 'none';
  activeProfile = null;
}


function closeModal(event) {
  if (event.target.id === 'ws-modal-overlay') closeKeyModal();
}


function submitKey() {
  if (!activeProfile || !workshopConfig) return;
  const cfg     = workshopConfig.profiles[activeProfile];
  const entered = document.getElementById('ws-key-input').value.trim();
  const errEl   = document.getElementById('ws-key-error');

  if (entered.toUpperCase() === cfg.key.toUpperCase()) {
    const trackToEnter = activeProfile; // 1. Save the track name
    WSProfile.unlock(trackToEnter);     //    remember it for the profile card
    closeKeyModal();                    // 2. Close modal (sets activeProfile to null)
    enterTrack(trackToEnter);           // 3. Use the saved track name!
  } else {
    errEl.textContent = 'Incorrect key — please try again.';
    const input = document.getElementById('ws-key-input');
    input.classList.add('ws-shake');
    setTimeout(() => { input.classList.remove('ws-shake'); input.select(); }, 600);
  }
}


// Escape key closes modal
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') closeKeyModal();
});


(function () {
  var boxes = document.querySelectorAll('.ws-step-done input[data-step]');
  var done = WSProfile.steps();
  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }

  function initials(name) {
    var p = name.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    return p.length ? (p[0][0] + (p.length > 1 ? p[p.length - 1][0] : '')).toUpperCase() : '?';
  }

  function refresh() {
    // steps of the plan
    var n = 0;
    boxes.forEach(function (box) {
      var on = !!done[box.dataset.step];
      box.checked = on;
      box.closest('.ws-step').classList.toggle('ws-step--done', on);
      if (on) n++;
    });
    $('ws-progress-fill').style.width = (100 * n / boxes.length) + '%';
    $('ws-progress-text').textContent = n + ' of ' + boxes.length + ' steps done';
    $('ws-profile-steps').textContent = n + '/' + boxes.length;

    // name and avatar: the Google account when signed in on Cloudflare, else the name typed here
    var user = cloudMe && cloudMe.user;
    var name = user ? user.name : WSProfile.name();
    var empty = serverGate() ? 'Sign in' : 'Set up your profile';
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-profile-name]').forEach(function (e) { e.textContent = name || empty; });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-profile-initials]').forEach(function (e) {
      e.textContent = initials(name);
      var old = e.querySelector('img'); if (old) old.remove();
      if (user && user.image) {
        var img = document.createElement('img');
        img.src = user.image; img.alt = ''; img.referrerPolicy = 'no-referrer';
        e.textContent = ''; e.appendChild(img);
      }
    });
    if (serverGate()) {
      var last = cloudMe && cloudMe.lastVisit;
      $('ws-continue').hidden = !last;
      if (last) {
        $('ws-continue').setAttribute('href', last.path);
        $('ws-continue-title').textContent = last.title || last.path;
      }
      var note = $('ws-profile-note');
      if (note && note.firstChild) note.firstChild.textContent = user
        ? 'Saved to your account: it follows you to any device you sign in on. '
        : 'Saved in this browser only. Sign in to keep it on any device. ';
      $('ws-profile-edit').textContent = user ? 'Account' : 'Sign in';
      document.querySelector('.ws-bar-profile').setAttribute('href', user ? '/account' : '/account?next=%2F');
    } else {
      $('ws-profile-edit').textContent = name ? 'Edit' : 'Add name';
    }

    // game: rank, XP, streak, badges
    var g = WSProfile.game();
    $('ws-profile-rank').textContent = g.rank;
    $('ws-profile-xp').textContent = g.xp;
    $('ws-profile-xp-fill').style.width = g.pct + '%';
    $('ws-profile-next').textContent = g.next ? (g.next[0] - g.xp) + ' XP to ' + g.next[1] : 'top rank reached';
    $('ws-profile-streak').textContent = g.streak;
    $('ws-profile-badges').textContent = g.badges;

    // one row per workshop: plan ticks, pre/post-test scores, live or greyed-out link
    var tests = WSProfile.tests();
    document.querySelectorAll('.ws-profile-tracks li').forEach(function (li) {
      var id = li.dataset.track;
      var total = WSProfile.planTotal(id, +li.dataset.total);
      var d = Math.min(WSProfile.planDone(id), total);
      li.querySelector('.ws-progress-bar span').style.width = (100 * d / total) + '%';
      li.querySelector('em').textContent = d + '/' + total;
      li.querySelectorAll('[data-test]').forEach(function (b) {
        var t = tests[b.dataset.test];
        b.textContent = t && typeof t.pct === 'number' ? t.pct + '%' : '–';
      });
      var qz = li.querySelector('.ws-pt-quiz');
      if (qz) {
        var q = WSProfile.quizzes(qz.dataset.folders.split(' '));
        qz.textContent = q.decks
          ? 'Quizzes: ' + q.decks + ' of ' + qz.dataset.decks + ' decks · ' + Math.round(100 * q.right / q.answered) + '% right first time'
          : 'Quizzes: none answered yet';
      }
      var link = li.querySelector('.ws-pt-link'), open = isUnlocked(id);
      var cfg = workshopConfig && workshopConfig.profiles[id];
      li.classList.toggle('ws-pt--locked', !open);
      if (open) {
        link.setAttribute('href', cfg ? cfg.path : id + '/welcome.html');
        link.removeAttribute('aria-disabled');
        link.removeAttribute('tabindex');
        link.textContent = 'Open →';
      } else {
        link.removeAttribute('href');
        link.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
        link.textContent = '🔒 Locked';
      }
    });
  }
  window.wsRefreshProfile = refresh;

  boxes.forEach(function (box) {
    box.addEventListener('change', function () {
      if (box.checked) done[box.dataset.step] = 1; else delete done[box.dataset.step];
      WSProfile.saveSteps(done);
      refresh();
    });
  });

  var form = $('ws-profile-form'), input = $('ws-profile-input');
  $('ws-profile-edit').addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (serverGate()) { window.location.href = cloudMe && cloudMe.user ? '/account' : '/account?next=%2F'; return; }
    form.hidden = !form.hidden;
    if (!form.hidden) { input.value = WSProfile.name(); input.focus(); }
  });
  form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    WSProfile.saveName(input.value);
    form.hidden = true;
    refresh();
  });

  refresh();
  // progress made in another tab (the game, a track home) shows up when you come back
  window.addEventListener('pageshow', refresh);
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { if (!document.hidden) refresh(); });
})();

loadConfig();
</script>
```
